chat.system_prompt: Answer in one or two short sentences.
chat.template_rule:
Turn 1 is [im_start] 'system
' + system [im_end] '
' [im_start] 'user
' + message [im_end] '
' [im_start] 'assistant
' [think] '

' [end_think] '

'. Text between markers is tokenized as plain text with special tokens disabled. A later turn appends exactly the generated tokens, then [im_end] if the reply did not end with it, then '
' [im_start] 'user
' + message [im_end] '
' [im_start] 'assistant
' [think] '

' [end_think] '

'. History is never rendered again.

sampling.procedure: Mask ids >= vocab_real. Divide scores by temperature. Keep the top_k by score (ties by lower id). Softmax in float32 over the kept scores: subtract the max, exp, sum in kept order. Sort by probability descending, ties by lower id. Keep the shortest prefix whose cumulative probability reaches top_p (at least one). Renormalize by the kept sum. Pick the first candidate whose cumulative probability exceeds u times the kept sum; if none, the last kept.

changes.floor_rule: middle = x + a * attention(x); output = middle + a * memory(middle)
changes.head_rule: the head's output (its mix of values, 128 numbers) is scaled before the output projection
changes.memory_rule: the memory block's output (after the down projection) is scaled
changes.hidden_rule: {key, from}: every head on every floor skips key position `key` for query positions >= `from`; a query left with nothing to look at outputs zero
changes.concept_rule: adds strength * rho[floor] * v to the stream entering `floor` at every position after the system turn; v has unit length
changes.swap_rule: exchanges two token ids at the dictionary lookup and in every read of the dictionary (scores, floor guesses, pushes, candidates)
changes.zeroed_rule: subtracts weight * input after the multiply, for one weight inside a floor
changes.bits_rule: a 16-entry table per bit width maps each 4-bit code to one of 2^bits evenly spaced levels between the group's lowest and highest level (codes 0 and 15); the dictionary keeps its precision
changes.push_rule: push of a part toward word t = (part output, already scaled by its multipliers and the floor multiplier) * final_norm_weight / rms(final stream at that position) . (dictionary[t] - mean of the real dictionary rows). The 476 parts (28 floors x (16 heads + 1 memory block)) plus the dictionary row's own push add up to t's score minus the mean score over real ids.
changes.push_order: dictionary row first, then for each floor 0..27: heads 0..15, then the memory block

numbering: Data uses zero-based floors, heads and positions. The interface shows floors and heads from 1, with the zero-based index in the details.
